title: The 10 Biggest Truck Recalls of 2025 and 2026, Ranked
description:
Ten of the biggest truck recalls of 2025 and 2026, ranked from smallest to biggest, with what failed, the fix, and what each one teaches a 2027 buyer. Every figure comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

0:00 Intro
3:04 10. Rivian R1T suspension
4:26 9. F-150 Lightning battery
5:38 8. Toyota Tacoma driveline
7:03 7. Tesla Cybertruck panels
8:48 6. Toyota Tundra
10:42 5. GM 6.2L V8
13:06 4. Ford cameras and fuel pumps
15:37 3. F-150 unexpected downshift
17:07 2. Ram 1500 seat belts
19:01 1. Ford trailer brakes and lights
21:33 What to check before you buy in 2027
